relations: Flow over the central rocky cascade continuously churns white water and generates subtle surface ripples.
These shifting ripples gently distort the mirrored reflections of the trees and bright sky patch.

caption: The video captures a calm, slow-moving river bordered on both banks by dense, sunlit green deciduous trees beneath a partly cloudy blue sky. The glassy foreground water mirrors the foliage and the bright sky patch, while fixed lens-flare artifacts hover at the upper-left and mid-left of the frame. A single pale stone rests at the left waterline, unmoving throughout the excerpt. In the mid-distance the channel narrows over a low rocky cascade, where a patch of white, disturbed water churns continuously. Small ripples form and shift across the surface from frame to frame, gently wavering and distorting the mirrored reflections. The white-water texture at the central cascade changes subtly, consistent with an ongoing gentle flow over the rocks. The overall framing and tree positions remain steady, with no pan, tilt, or zoom evident in the visible portion.
